notes: Revenue, operating income and valuation are Forbes estimates (2026 list, 2025 season). Player expenses ($364M) and stadium facts come from an August 2026 snapshot of the Forbes team profile, whose figures are for the 2024 season; the profile names the venue NRG Stadium, while the club's site now calls it Reliant Stadium. Janice McNair (co-founder, senior chair) died 14 July 2026 per houstontexans.com; how her interest passed is not stated. No stake percentages, legal entity, kit supplier, honours, attendance or social counts found on citable pages. No private-equity or other institutional stake found.
